A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (29 September 2022). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-kalfalnlcndros-PC-Errata-2022-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Kal'Falnl C'ndros (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (8 July 2018): The game text changes: “total battle” is added after “higher, reduces opponent's”; “deploy to or board” becomes “be aboard”. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels, with the mark “D-E1” in the lower border in place of the “E”.

The whole 2018 E card image and the whole 2022 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
